## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The new write path needs key normalization because mixed-case writes cannot be retrieved. Tests were read, not run.

## Changes
The pull request adds `Cache.set()`, increases the default TTL to 300 seconds, and adds round-trip and expiry tests.

## Important
- app/cache.py:27 — correctness — Normalize keys before storing them — After `set("ALPHA", 1)`, both `get("alpha")` and `get("ALPHA")` return `None`. You store the original key, while `get()` lowercases every lookup and expiry deletion. — Callers writing uppercase or mixed-case keys lose access to cached values, and those entries escape expiry cleanup.
